text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The day of the All Comers. On that day, 
everyone—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Everyone was fighting. Against their own 
respective "fears."

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Teio!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: Don't quit, Teio!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Everyone, thanks for coming!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
For so many people to come out just for 
someone like me, who hasn't even been able 
to run properly... It makes me so happy!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
At least give them one final, 
extraordinary stage...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Yes, I... I can't race anymore...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: “—I'm in your care today, Rice-san.”

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"I doubt I can be much of a match for you, 
but please go easy on me."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah…… Such incredible intensity…… She 
might be a formidable opponent……

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: In that case—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Aaaah~, she really went and did it. 
Hijacking the broadcast booth~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Nature, this means cleaning duty 
punishment is guaranteed, right? Right, 
right~?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I've got this handled! We're all 
set to play the race footage.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: "The rest is up to Turbo! Do your best!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I get a message from Nice Nature. With 
this, the preparations are complete.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Right, and then—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Past the 3rd corner... dash... But before 
dashing, what if...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
What if someone comes from behind...? What 
if everyone catches up and attacks me all 
at once...?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: —!? What!?
choice_data_list:
It's okay, let's just focus on beating 
yourself!
It's okay, let's try to outdo ourselves

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: To myself...
choice_data_list: Yeah, you can do it, Turbo!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If you're targeted, it's over. An 
insurmountable wall for an ordinary 
person. Even so—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Only Twin Turbo and her chaotic running 
can smash through that wall. If Twin Turbo 
wins—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It can blow away all fears. And Tokai Teio 
too—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
You're right, Trainer. Turbo's... gonna do 
this.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Everyone is so quick to say it. 'You can't 
do it, can't do it, can't do it.' 'There's 
no way you can win.' But...!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
That's not true! Not at all! Turbo's 
gonna—show you!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: What it really means to "never give up"!!
